NewsArticle.Title: The Entreaty
NewsArticle.Content: & 99.09.19, Afternoon The Grimlok Queen writes her plea: For centuries we have dwelt in mountainside labor, alone to our cycle and to our kith. We have searched the layers of our past and disturbing history. Our history is now being taken from us. Of the last full moon Grimlok diggers discovered a dark fragment. No more than a chunk of rock at first sight, yet our shaman sensed more. It is a fragment of the Grimlok's calling stone. A stone we have remembered only in atavistic dreams. It summons a creature from the nature of the possessor: Good for good; Evil for evil. I pray it remain with the Good. This was a month ago, and I would have kept it secret as it our stone; of Grimlok heritage. But the goblins have discovered it somehow. They slaughter our kith, our kin. Aislings, we call out to you. By a show of our gratitude we shall let the Holy Object be used by the religion that aids our desperate cause. My warrior will provide the necessary details. - Queen of the Grimlok Enter Dark Ages, listen to the Events of Temuair and talk to your Shrine's assistant to learn more.
